title: Verify the user and roles provisioned by the User Onboarding Agent
preconditions: SANDBOX ONLY. The FastTrack User Onboarding Agent has onboarded a test employee. Replace {userId} with that user's ID and {approvedRole} with the security role approved in the Teams card. The account used to run this test must be allowed to open the Users form; the Dynamics 365 ERP MCP server cannot open it, but the web client can. Read-only: do not assign or remove roles.

steps.action: Navigate to Modules > System administration > Users > Users.
Find the user with User ID '{userId}'.
steps.expected: The user exists and is enabled.
The role '{approvedRole}' is assigned, and no role that was not approved appears.
